subtitle: إتقان — daily tasks, habits and long-term goals in one calm place
next_actions: In Settings → Profile, pick your interface language (it follows you to your other devices). All four translations have had their independent review (S2-23); if a phrase still reads oddly, note it.
On the laptop: git pull, then re-run scripts/install_local.sh (it installs new dependencies itself now). Then open Itqan on the iPhone once so it updates (data format v6) and syncs again.
Look at the new daily card on Today; in Settings → Daily card, choose the word's language and level and switch off anything you don't want.
Record this year's achievements so far; check the suggestions Itqan offers.

log.entry: S2-26: data format v8 for Training — exercises, routines, program, workouts and sets (sets as their own collection so two devices logging one workout keep every set), Goal.link, Settings.weightUnit (kg). The upgrade adds only empty collections and defaults; tested from v7 data and a v7 backup, through sync (program absent until saved, so a fresh device stays fresh), and every store action incl. the linked-habit tick and its undo. Nothing visible yet.

Training (exercise and gym tracking), at the owner's request: spec agreed in chat and kept in memory/11-training.md — exercises, routines, a program by weekdays or rotation (customizable), live workouts with last time, effort per set, rest timer and suggestions, PRs, history by day and exercise, kg by default, logging on laptop and phone. Decision record ADR-027; built as S2-26 to S2-31.

S2-25, from the owner's report: "New goal" on the Goals page closed without creating anything — since the first commit. Cause: the editor saved with onCreated?.(add(goal)), and an optional call skips its arguments when there is no callback, which is exactly the Goals page (Plan and Projects passed one, so it worked there). Fixed, and src/lib/__tests__/sourceGuards.test.ts now fails on any optional call with a call in its arguments. Also at the owner's request: goal cards are about half as tall — progress ring, title, area and pace, one line of facts, and a quick + (numeric) or the next milestone to tick; the whole card opens a details dialog with the why, all milestones, the progress history and every action (ADR-026). Checked in the browser at 375 and 1280 px, light and dark, English and Arabic.

S2-24, at the owner's request: the onboarding starter set no longer mirrors his own routine (this repository is public). It is now a generic example in all five languages — Health, Mind, Learning, Books, Work, Life; habits like Drink water, Read, Meditate, Exercise; goals Read 12 books, Run 5 km, Learn a new skill, Finish an online course. Onboarding text, quick-add examples and memory/00-project.md follow suit; the routine is kept only in the private, local notes. Existing data is untouched — the starter set is only created at first run (ADR-025).

Phone navigation, at the owner's request: the bottom bar's fifth item is now More (the menu) instead of Focus; the sheet it opens lists Projects, Focus, Ideas and every other screen. The header's menu button is gone (it duplicated More). A running focus timer shows as a dot on More and a countdown on the Focus tile, so it isn't hidden behind the menu.

S2-23: independent review of every translation against its language guide, one reviewer for the screens and one for the daily-card content per language, language by language — Arabic 87 fixes, French 53, Chinese 56, Spanish 59 (meaning, calques, grammar, glossary consistency, hadith checked against the Arabic, Chinese-word definitions that were only synonyms, Spain-only words in Spanish, one Quran excerpt re-cut). Code fixes the reviewers found: signed numbers (“+5 XP”) kept their sign in front in right-to-left; “None” in pickers per thing picked (gender in French/Spanish); “every week” no longer “every 1 week” in Chinese (tested); a project with no tasks gets its own delete confirmation; habit streak labels read right under any number; GitHub’s English-only labels quoted as they are; the English of Bukhari 3559 now says “Among the best of you”. Rules added to memory/10-localization.md.

S2-07: Itqan in English, Arabic (right to left), French, Chinese and Spanish (ADR-024, schema v7) — every screen, quick add (day words per language, tested), and the daily card (published Quran meanings for French/Spanish/Chinese, verified; hadith, wisdom, facts and 1,000 word meanings translated). Automated translation checks for completeness, placeholders, plural forms, typography and leftover English all pass. The independent per-language review was stopped before it finished and is follow-up S2-23.

S2-00 follow-up: install_local.sh now runs `npm ci` whenever package-lock.json is newer than npm's record of the last install, so `git pull` + the script is the whole update — before, a pull that added a package (ADR-023's font) broke the build until a manual `npm install`. `npm ci`, not `npm install`: it never rewrites tracked files that would block the next pull. Checked: up to date → skipped; changed lockfile → installed; checkout stays clean.

S2-21, S2-22: the daily card on Today (ADR-023, schema v6) — 118 Quran passages (KFGQPC Uthmani in Amiri Quran, open-tanween code points mapped to Standard Unicode and proven on all 6,236 ayahs; Saheeh International), 102 hadith (Arabic copied from the cited hadith; al-Bukhari, Muslim, or sahih/hasan per al-Albani, grade shown), 81 sayings, 115 facts, and words of the day for French, English, German, Spanish and Chinese at A1–C2 (French B1: 90). scripts/verify_daily.py checks every verse and hadith word for word (negative-tested). One of each per day, the same on every device; laptop: top of the side column, phone: one folded line. Settings → Daily card. 129 tests; checked in the browser at 375/768/1280 px, light and dark; v5 → v6 upgrade verified on browser data.

S2-19, S2-20: Achievements (ADR-022, schema v5) — year in review, categories incl. custom, impact, highlights, proof links, suggestions from goals/projects/streaks/focus, text export; goal and project completion offer 'Add to achievements'. Game rewards renamed Badges. Tested end to end in the browser at phone and laptop sizes.

S2-16…S2-18: project boards, manual progress, pace, next action, updates and pinning (ADR-020, schema v4); blank-page bug fixed by removing waiting page transitions (ADR-021). 103 tests; board, progress, updates and pinning exercised in the browser at phone and laptop sizes; the real v3→v4 upgrade verified on browser data.

S2-13…S2-15: Projects (ADR-019) and Connections (ADR-018), schema v3. Check-in rules and birthday maths tested; people reuse reminders, so desktop alerts, Calendar export and sync work for them. Both features exercised in the browser at phone and laptop sizes; no screen overflows.

UI fixes: dialogs portalled to <body> (sync setup's buttons were clipped on desktop; the ☰ menu covered the phone's top bar), phone layouts for Habits/Plan/Reminders, 16 px fields (no iOS zoom), safe-area padding and touch icon for the home-screen app, no sideways scrolling. Every screen checked at 375/768/1280 px.

Live: the app is published on GitHub Pages (code repo public, scrubbed of personal details, no-reply commit identity). Sync connected on laptop and iPhone; the encrypted file was verified to hold no readable text, and a task created on the iPhone arrived on the laptop.

S4-01…S4-04: encrypted GitHub sync (ADR-016) — per-entity merge with stamps and tombstones, AES-GCM/PBKDF2, sha-checked writes with retry; 22 new tests incl. an engine test against a fake GitHub that forces a real save conflict. iPhone reminders via .ics Calendar export (ADR-017). Waiting on the owner's GitHub setup to go live.

S2-08…S2-11: Memories, Ideas and Reminders. Schema v2 (migration tested, and verified on real v1 data in the browser). Desktop notifications through the itqan-reminders user service (ADR-013): token + origin + host guards each tested by attack; end-to-end test from the file:// app delivered a notification.

S2-00: Itqan now runs as a local app with no server — a single offline HTML file opened by an 'Itqan' launcher in Chrome app mode with its own profile (ADR-012). Verified that data persists across a Chrome restart.
Stages 0 and 1 built in one session: the full daily-use MVP, 32 tests, CI and Pages deploy, and the proven memory system. Verified in the browser on desktop and phone widths, light and dark.
